prompts.prompt: Scientific educational photorealistic two-panel exercise illustration for Tempo: Développé épaules avec tubes et poignées. Reference image identity/clothes ONLY: same adult man navy shirt, navy shorts, gray sneakers. TWO equal side-by-side panels, one full person each, fixed three-quarter camera and SAME scale, offwhite studio floor/background, no text numbers arrows logo border. Generous margins around feet hands and tubes in EACH half. Equipment MUST be small diameter ROUND GRAY TUBULAR resistance elastic, black webbing handles with carabiners, NOT flat rubber bands or mini-loop. Exact setup: standing on middle of thin gray resistance tube UNDER BOTH SHOES, feet shoulder-width, one black carabiner handle per hand, two tube segments run along OUTSIDE legs and arms without winding around body. LEFT: elbows bent, handles at shoulder height, forearms upright, palms forward. RIGHT: both arms pressed upward overhead, elbows comfortably extended, handles above shoulders, torso remains upright without arching. Same foot positions and camera, physically coherent connected tube path, no disappearing tube or extra limbs. Clear equipment and shoe contacts. No other equipment.

Reference identity/clothes ONLY: same adult man dark hair navy T-shirt navy shorts gray trainers. Two equal SIDE-BY-SIDE panels, exactly one complete man and one complete CLOSED DOOR per panel, identical three-quarter camera showing whole man, BOTH HANDLES, full tube paths and anchor. Pale studio wall/floor, no extra furnishings, no text arrows numbers logos borders. ROUND THIN GRAY TUBES, black handles/carabiners, black short door-anchor strap, NOT flat bands, NOT a pulley machine. Setup: closed light-gray door with black door-anchor strap at CHEST HEIGHT in hinge-side gap, gray tube centered through anchor loop, tube ends to two black handles, man standing with BACK TOWARD door in staggered stance facing away. RIGHT: both arms press forward in front of chest, elbows comfortably extended, same feet and torso, tubes connect handles back to door. Keep exact same body orientation and door location between panels. Entire door and person with generous margins in each half. No clipped feet/hands and no duplicated limbs.
